fixed_predictor_source.rule: Use the stored scaler mean/scale, logistic coefficients/intercept and threshold 0.5 exactly; no retraining, threshold tuning, feature revision or family-specific calibration.

purpose: Untouched multi-family n=16 transfer test after C588 showed that the frozen v0 predictor retained quartic positives but lost all selectivity. Selectivity/open-rate and charged compute savings are co-primary with final-quality regret. C588 outcomes may motivate this test design but may not be used to recalibrate the frozen predictor.
canonicalization: Wrap every generated graph as nx.Graph(generator_output) before deriving natural/RCM/seeded orders so NetworkX adjacency insertion order matches the validated v0/C588 harness convention.

seeded_start.choice: same max-min normalized Kendall rule as v0

features: exact frozen v0 19-feature vector before any seeded BDD compilation
label: seeded strictly beats natural and RCM after one local-search stage; ties negative

policies.always_three: same frozen v0 three-arm controller, max 2 accepted moves

co_primary_criteria.charged_compute: fixed_learned_gate candidate compilations at least 10% lower than always_three across all 24 cases
co_primary_criteria.quality_safety: fixed_learned_gate summed final live nodes must equal always_three summed final live nodes; report every per-case positive regret. Any positive aggregate regret is a safety failure for this holdout.

predeclared_tests: Report overall and family-stratified label prevalence, gate open-rate, probability distribution, TN/FP/FN/TP and AUROC only when both classes exist.
Report learned_gate vs always_three candidate compilations, percentage reduction, summed final live nodes and total/max per-case live-node regret.
Report every learned-gate false negative and every case with final live-node regret, even if the one-stage label is negative.
Compare the preregistered width+1 gate and plain two-arm on the same frozen cases as secondary baselines.
All completed endpoints must match exhaustive truth-bitset and exact Hamming-rank oracle.
Do not change model, threshold, features, seeds, generators, criteria or label after observing outcomes. Any revised gate requires a new untouched split.
decision_rule: The frozen v0 selective cost-amortization hypothesis transfers on this holdout only if all three co-primary criteria pass. Catching positives while opening on most cases is not selective success. If no one-stage positives occur, classification recall is inconclusive but open-rate/compute/quality criteria remain evaluable.
scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering on these 24 fixed n=16 cases only. This is not a general BDD or proof-search policy claim.
